* '''Only version''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the alternate-image card with this text, under the title •Galen Marek, Starkiller<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>. No earlier printing of the alternate image is known: neither copy of the Virtual Block 4 release sheet has an AI slip for this card (only Black Leader has one, 02AI), and the 2011 PC card directory and the 2012–13 PC website card lists have no Galen AI. The regular card's original text (“with Fallen Jedi”, “with Black Leader”, under the title •Galen, Secret Apprentice) is [[Galen, Secret Apprentice (V)]]; an earlier record of an AI printing with that text, which rested only on the Players Committee's card data, was folded into this page.
